identification: German Empire, Prussia, Wilhelm II 5 Mark 1913 (KM 536, .900 silver, about 27.8g, about 28g melt roughly 1.0 oz x .9 = 0.80 oz fine) in a silver filigree bezel on a long paperclip-link chain claimed 835. Mint mark not visible in photos (A most likely, 1.96m minted of 1913A). Mounted, so numismatic premium largely gone; value is mostly silver weight plus a small jewellery premium.

viewing_check: Weigh the whole piece if allowed; look for 835 or 800 stamp on the clasp and bezel; read the mint letter under the eagle (A, D, E, F, G, J) and the obverse to confirm it is a real Prussia 1913 5 mark and not a copy or restrike; check the coin is not a plated copy (magnet, edge lettering); check chain solder and clasp for repair.
